I had an amazing experience with this cat grooming service! I called at 2 PM, and by 5 PM, they were already at my place—talk about fast and reliable! The groomer was incredibly professional and kind. My street cat was treated like royalty, and the results were perfect. He looks absolutely amazing—clean, fluffy, and happy. Highly recommend if you want top-notch care and quick service for your furry friend!

I couldn’t be happier with the service from Mobile Pet Grooming VIP! Dylan did an amazing job with my cat, and I was so impressed with his patience and care throughout the entire grooming process. My cat can be a bit nervous around new people, but Dylan handled her so gently and made her feel completely at ease. It’s clear he truly cares about the animals he works with. The convenience of having them come to my home was a huge plus too. I’m beyond grateful for Dylan and the excellent service—I’ll definitely be booking again. Highly recommend!
